description.value: Raclette Steaks is a casual steak sandwich and burger restaurant on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, specializing in Philly cheesesteaks and Swiss raclette-style steak sandwiches made with AAA beef, housemade cheese sauce, and freshly baked bread. The restaurant offers a calm, cosy indoor dining atmosphere with no outdoor seating. Touring cyclists passing through Vancouver's West End would find it a convenient sit-down meal stop on one of the city's main pedestrian and cycling corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 39m; stands (2 spaces) at 57m; stands (4 spaces) at 92m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the restaurant at 1232 Robson St, Vancouver, BC V6E 1C2, matching OSM address. The site has an 'Order Online' link, confirming takeout is available. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags; a suspicious out-of-place line ('8056 King George is Kebab bey') appears on the /hours-location/ subpage, suggesting possible spam or SEO injection.
concerns: The /hours-location/ subpage contains a suspicious out-of-place entry — '8056 King George is Kebab bey' — which may indicate spam injection or SEO content pollution on the website.
No phone number present in OSM or on the website.
Opening hours differ between the front page (11am–10pm Mon–Sat) and the /hours-location/ subpage (10am–11pm Mon–Sat), suggesting the website content may not be carefully maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website or OSM. Warrants review to verify cyclist amenities before inclusion.
